svg.title: Tech stack as a gold-mining game: an old miner swings a claw over gold nuggets, each embossed with a technology logo. Languages: C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript. Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, React, Next.js, Tailwind. Backend, database and cloud: Node.js, Express, Supabase, MySQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. Tools: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Figma, VS Code.
